topic: Memory Hierarchy and Caching Strategies: Time Reduction
explanation: Modern computer systems employ a memory hierarchy to bridge the speed gap between CPU and main memory.  This hierarchy consists of multiple levels of storage with varying speeds and capacities.  Caches, the fastest level, store frequently accessed data closer to the CPU, reducing access time.  Effective caching strategies are crucial for optimizing program performance.
